description: This file defines a Flutter widget for the books management page, including listing, searching, and basic CRUD controls for books, with UI components and state management.

classes.name: BooksPage
classes.description: A StatefulWidget that provides a user interface for listing and searching books, as well as initiating add/edit/delete actions.

classes.name: _BooksPageState
classes.description: The state class managing the UI and logic for the BooksPage, including pagination, searching, and loading book data.

methods.name: initState
methods.description: Initializes the state and triggers the initial loading of books.

methods.name: _loadBooks
methods.description: Asynchronously loads the list of books from the API with optional search and pagination parameters.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree rendering the books list, search input, and action buttons.
